import json,os
demo_in=[[5,5,5],[5,5,5],[2,2,2],[5,5,5],[5,3,5],[2,2,2],[5,5,5],[5,5,5]]
demo_out=[[5,5,5],[5,3,5],[2,2,2],[5,5,5],[5,3,5],[2,2,2],[5,5,5],[5,3,5]]

def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # contiguous block of rows that aren't all-background
    nb=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(x!=bg for x in r)]
    # take the largest contiguous run containing the "pattern" rows (non-uniform)
    runs=[];cur=[]
    for i in range(h):
        if i in nb: cur.append(i)
        else:
            if cur: runs.append(cur); cur=[]
    if cur: runs.append(cur)
    # choose run containing a row with 2+ colors (the pattern)
    block=None
    for run in runs:
        if any(len(set(g[i]))>1 for i in run): block=run
    if block is None: block=runs[0] if runs else []
    a,b=block[0],block[-1]
    L=b-a+1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(h):
        if not (a<=i<=b):
            out[i]=g[a+((i-a)%L)][:]
    return out
print(transform(demo_in)==demo_out)
test=[[9,9,9,9,9,9,9,8,9],[9,5,2,9,1,9,9,6,1],[3,9,9,9,9,9,9,6,9],[9,7,9,9,7,9,9,9,8],[0]*9,[9]*9,[9]*9,[9]*9,[9]*9]

prog='''def transform(grid):
    # Vertical periodic tiling of a pattern block, with optional one-row separator
    # (uniform row in a color appearing only there) kept in place; background fills gaps.
    from collections import Counter
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    colors=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r)
    bg=colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep=None
    for i,r in enumerate(grid):
        if all(x==r[0] for x in r) and colors[r[0]]==w:
            sep=i; break
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    if sep is not None:
        block=grid[:sep]
        L=len(block); period=L+1
        for i in range(sep+1,h):
            j=(i-sep-1)%period
            out[i]=block[j][:] if j<L else [bg]*w
        return out
    # no separator: block = contiguous non-bg run containing a non-uniform row
    nb=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if any(x!=bg for x in r)]
    runs=[];cur=[]
    for i in range(h):
        if i in nb: cur.append(i)
        else:
            if cur: runs.append(cur); cur=[]
    if cur: runs.append(cur)
    block=None
    for run in runs:
        if any(len(set(grid[i]))>1 for i in run): block=run
    if block is None: return out
    a=block[0]; L=len(block); period=L+1
    for i in range(h):
        if a<=i<a+L: continue
        j=(i-a)%period
        out[i]=grid[a+j][:] if j<L else [bg]*w
    return out
'''
